text:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in OOMs on cluster-gamma (us-west2) — 12 container restarts in 10m. Error sample: `cudaErrorUnknown` / cuda mem alloc fail. Incident created INC-2026-176666.

alex: I'm oncall — seeing repeated restarts for rw-infer-7. attaching eng-oncall. will start triage.

priya: quick note from perf traces — kv-cache rss grows slowly over long traces (minutes) before crash, not a single allocation spike. looks like slow creep + fragmentation in paged allocator. paging + small-slab retention.

sam: routing: shifting traffic off node-7 to fallback-pool now (50% -> 100% over 2m). initiating cancel on long-running requests to minimize churn.

marta: draining node-7 and restarting. also patching env to be more aggressive on evictions for the time being: `kubectl set env ds/rw-infer-kv KV_EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.6 --namespace=prod`

priya: logs snippet from before crash:
```
[2026-06-12T03:21:10Z] kvcache: slab_util=0.12 frag=0.78 total_pages=13421
[2026-06-12T03:24:05Z] pager: alloc request 1.2GB failed -> cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
[2026-06-12T03:24:05Z] runtime: container exited code=137 reason="OOM"
[2026-06-12T03:24:05Z] kvcache: compaction deferred (retention_window=300s)
```

alex: customer impact: 3 tenants saw 95th p99 latency increase ~700ms; one tenant returned 503s during node flaps. PMs + support pinged.

sam: hotfix plan: change paged allocator compaction interval 300s -> 60s and enable `sweep_on_alloc=true`. roll to a single canary node first.

priya: I have a minimal allocator change (reduce retention window and trigger async compaction on hit). will open PR and attach microbench results. if canary looks good, roll.

oncall-bot: deploy started: commit abc123 -> canary node-8 (tag: kvcache-hotfix-20260612). ETA ~3m.

marta: canary up 7m, memory trend shows flattening and small drop after compaction triggered. node-8 has been stable. proceeding rolling restart across cluster-gamma with 1m pause between pods.

alex: added short-term runbook entry: if OOMs observed, run `kc-evict --percent=30 --grace=10s` for affected node, then restart pod. and enable traffic shift to fallback pool until node stabilizes.

sam: added automatic routing rule: if container restarts >5 in 10m for a given node, route to smaller-quantized model pool and alert infra.

priya: will capture telemetry (heap growth plots, frag ratio) and try to reproduce locally with long-running synthetic workload. follow-up PR for more aggressive on-alloc compaction + metric for retained_pages.

oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-176666 status -> mitigated, monitoring 60m. severity: sev2.

alex: thanks everyone. continuing watch for 1h. if anything new pops up ping here. :thumbsup:

priya: posting reproducer + PR link in #eng-runtime when ready.

alex: closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
